# RecipeHub

> A social recipe-sharing web app. Members publish their own recipes with
> photos, follow other cooks, and save what they want to make. It also
> surfaces a catalogue of reference meals and drinks pulled from
> two free public food databases.

RecipeHub is a MERN application: a React single-page frontend and an
Express/MongoDB API. Recipes written by members are first-party content;
meal and drink pages under /meals and /drinks are reference data from
third-party sources, credited below.

## Pages

- [Home](__SITE_URL__/): What RecipeHub is and how to join.
- [Explore](__SITE_URL__/explore): Every member-published recipe, newest first, plus trending hashtags.
- [Popular meals and drinks](__SITE_URL__/popular-meals): Reference dishes browsable by category (beef, chicken, dessert, seafood, vegetarian, pasta) and cocktails.
- [Random meal](__SITE_URL__/random-meal): A randomly selected reference recipe, reshuffled on demand.
- [Cuisines](__SITE_URL__/cuisines): Reference dishes grouped by the cuisine they belong to; each cuisine has its own page.
- [Ingredients](__SITE_URL__/ingredients): The full ingredient list, filterable, with a page per ingredient listing the dishes that use it.
- [Register](__SITE_URL__/register): Create an account to publish, save and follow.
- [Login](__SITE_URL__/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Content types

- Community recipes (`/recipes/:id`): title, ingredients, instructions, hashtags, photos, author, likes, comments. Written by RecipeHub members.
- Reference meals (`/meals/:id`): dish name, category, cuisine, ingredients, instructions, photo, and where available a cooking video.
- Reference drinks (`/drinks/:id`): drink name, category, glassware, ingredients, instructions, photo.
- Member profiles (`/users/:id`): a cook's published recipes and follower counts.
- Tag pages (`/tag/:tag`): every community recipe carrying a given hashtag.

## Attribution

Reference meal data is provided by [TheMealDB](https://www.themealdb.com).
Reference drink data is provided by [TheCocktailDB](https://www.thecocktaildb.com).
Community recipe text and photos belong to the members who published them.

## Notes for automated readers

- Private areas (feed, messages, notifications, saved recipes, profile
  management) require authentication and are marked noindex.
- Recipe pages carry schema.org `Recipe` structured data; listing pages
  carry `BreadcrumbList` and `ItemList` where applicable.
